5269  END
5270  SUBROUTINE ma27ad(N,NZ,IRN,ICN,IW,LIW,IKEEP,IW1,NSTEPS,IFLAG,
5271  + icntl,cntl,info,ops)
5272  INTEGER iflag,liw,n,nsteps,nz
5273  DOUBLE PRECISION cntl(5),ops
5274  INTEGER icntl(30),info(20)
5275  INTEGER icn(*),ikeep(n,3),irn(*),iw(liw),iw1(n,2)
5276  INTEGER i,iwfr,k,l1,l2,lliw
5277  EXTERNAL ma27gd,ma27hd,ma27jd,ma27kd,ma27ld,ma27md,ma27ud
5278  INTRINSIC min
5279  DO 5 i = 1,15
5280  info(i) = 0
5281  5 CONTINUE
5282  IF (icntl(3).LE.0 .OR. icntl(2).LE.0) go to 40
5283  WRITE (icntl(2),fmt=10) n,nz,liw,iflag
5284  10 FORMAT(/,/,' ENTERING MA27AD WITH N NZ LIW IFLAG',
5285  + /,21x,i7,i7,i9,i7)
5286  nsteps = 0
5287  k = min(8,nz)
5288  IF (icntl(3).GT.1) k = nz
5289  IF (k.GT.0) WRITE (icntl(2),fmt=20) (irn(i),icn(i),i=1,k)
5290  20 FORMAT (' MATRIX NON-ZEROS',/,4 (i9,i6),/,
5291  + (i9,i6,i9,i6,i9,i6,i9,i6))
5292  k = min(10,n)
5293  IF (icntl(3).GT.1) k = n
5294  IF (iflag.EQ.1 .AND. k.GT.0) THEN
5295  WRITE (icntl(2),fmt=30) (ikeep(i,1),i=1,k)
5296  END IF
5297  30 FORMAT (' IKEEP(.,1)=',10i6,/, (12x,10i6))
5298  40 IF (n.LT.1 .OR. n.GT.icntl(4)) go to 70
5299  IF (nz.LT.0) go to 100
5300  lliw = liw - 2*n
5301  l1 = lliw + 1
5302  l2 = l1 + n
5303  IF (iflag.EQ.1) go to 50
5304  IF (liw.LT.2*nz+3*n+1) go to 130
5305  CALL ma27gd(n,nz,irn,icn,iw,lliw,iw1,iw1(1,2),iw(l1),iwfr,
5306  + icntl,info)
5307  CALL ma27hd(n,iw1,iw,lliw,iwfr,iw(l1),iw(l2),ikeep(1,2),
5308  + ikeep(1,3),ikeep,icntl(4),info(11),cntl(2))
5309  go to 60
5310  50 IF (liw.LT.nz+3*n+1) go to 120
5311  CALL ma27jd(n,nz,irn,icn,ikeep,iw,lliw,iw1,iw1(1,2),iw(l1),iwfr,
5312  + icntl,info)
5313  CALL ma27kd(n,iw1,iw,lliw,iwfr,ikeep,ikeep(1,2),iw(l1),iw(l2),
5314  + info(11))
5315  60 CALL ma27ld(n,iw1,iw(l1),ikeep,ikeep(1,2),ikeep(1,3),iw(l2),
5316  + nsteps,icntl(5))
5317  IF(nz.GE.1) iw(1) = irn(1) + 1
5318  CALL ma27md(n,nz,irn,icn,ikeep,ikeep(1,3),ikeep(1,2),iw(l2),
5319  + nsteps,iw1,iw1(1,2),iw,info,ops)
5320  go to 160
5321  70 info(1) = -1
5322  IF (icntl(1).GT.0) WRITE (icntl(1),fmt=80) info(1)
5323  80 FORMAT (' **** ERROR RETURN FROM MA27AD **** INFO(1)=',i3)
5324  IF (icntl(1).GT.0) WRITE (icntl(1),fmt=90) n
5325  90 FORMAT (' VALUE OF N OUT OF RANGE ... =',i10)
5326  go to 160
5327  100 info(1) = -2
5328  IF (icntl(1).GT.0) WRITE (icntl(1),fmt=80) info(1)
5329  IF (icntl(1).GT.0) WRITE (icntl(1),fmt=110) nz
5330  110 FORMAT (' VALUE OF NZ OUT OF RANGE .. =',i10)
5331  go to 160
5332  120 info(2) = nz + 3*n + 1
5333  go to 140
5334  130 info(2) = 2*nz + 3*n + 1
5335  140 info(1) = -3
5336  IF (icntl(1).GT.0) WRITE (icntl(1),fmt=80) info(1)
5337  IF (icntl(1).GT.0) WRITE (icntl(1),fmt=150) liw,info(2)
5338  150 FORMAT (' LIW TOO SMALL, MUST BE INCREASED FROM',i10,
5339  + ' TO AT LEAST',i10)
5340  160 IF (icntl(3).LE.0 .OR. icntl(2).LE.0 .OR. info(1).LT.0) go to 200
5341  WRITE (icntl(2),fmt=170) nsteps,info(1),ops,info(2),info(3),
5342  + info(4),info(5),info(6),info(7),info(8),info(11)
5343  170 FORMAT (/,' LEAVING MA27AD WITH NSTEPS INFO(1) OPS IERROR',
5344  + ' NRLTOT NIRTOT',
5345  + /,20x,2i7,f7.0,3i7,
5346  + /,20x,' NRLNEC NIRNEC NRLADU NIRADU NCMPA',
5347  + /,20x,6i7)
5348  k = min(9,n)
5349  IF (icntl(3).GT.1) k = n
5350  IF (k.GT.0) WRITE (icntl(2),fmt=30) (ikeep(i,1),i=1,k)
5351  k = min(k,nsteps)
5352  IF (k.GT.0) WRITE (icntl(2),fmt=180) (ikeep(i,2),i=1,k)
5353  180 FORMAT (' IKEEP(.,2)=',10i6,/, (12x,10i6))
5354  IF (k.GT.0) WRITE (icntl(2),fmt=190) (ikeep(i,3),i=1,k)
5355  190 FORMAT (' IKEEP(.,3)=',10i6,/, (12x,10i6))

5358  END

5361  SUBROUTINE ma27bd(N,NZ,IRN,ICN,A,LA,IW,LIW,IKEEP,NSTEPS,MAXFRT,

5363  INTEGER la,liw,maxfrt,n,nsteps,nz

5372  info(1) = 0

5376  + ' ENTERING MA27BD WITH N NZ LA LIW',

5379 
5380  IF (icntl(3).GT.1) kz = nz
5381

5385  + (1x,1p,d16.3,2i6,1p,d16.3,2i6))
5386 
5387 
5388  k = min(9,n)
5389  IF (icntl(3).GT.1) k = n
5390

5393  k = min(k,nsteps)

5396  IF (k.GT.0) WRITE (icntl(2),fmt=50) (ikeep(i,3),i=1,k)
5397  50 FORMAT (' IKEEP(.,3)=',10i6,/, (12x,10i6))
5398 
5399 
5400  60 IF (n.LT.1 .OR. n.GT.icntl(4)) go to 70
5401 
5402  IF (nz.LT.0) go to 100
5403  IF (liw.LT.nz) go to 120
5404  IF (la.LT.nz+n) go to 150
5405  IF (nsteps.LT.1 .OR. nsteps.GT.n) go to 175

5407  IF (info(1).EQ.-3) go to 130
5408  IF (info(1).EQ.-4) go to 160
5409  CALL ma27od(n,nz1,a,la,iw,liw,ikeep,ikeep(1,3),nsteps,maxfrt,
5410  + ikeep(1,2),iw1,icntl,cntl,info)
5411  IF (info(1).EQ.-3) go to 130
5412  IF (info(1).EQ.-4) go to 160
5413  IF (info(1).EQ.-5) go to 180
5414  IF (info(1).EQ.-6) go to 200
5415  IF (info(1).EQ.3 .AND. icntl(2).GT.0) THEN
5416  WRITE (icntl(2),fmt=65) info(1),info(2)
5417  END IF
5418 
5419  65 FORMAT (' *** WARNING MESSAGE FROM SUBROUTINE MA27BD',
5420  + ' *** INFO(1) =',i2,
5421  + /,5x,'MATRIX IS SINGULAR. RANK=',i5)
5422  go to 220
5423  70 info(1) = -1
5424 
5425  IF (icntl(1).GT.0) WRITE (icntl(1),fmt=80) info(1)

5427  IF (icntl(1).GT.0) WRITE (icntl(1),fmt=90) n
5428  90 FORMAT (' VALUE OF N OUT OF RANGE ... =',i10)
5429  go to 220
5430  100 info(1) = -2
5431  IF (icntl(1).GT.0) WRITE (icntl(1),fmt=80) info(1)
5432  IF (icntl(1).GT.0) WRITE (icntl(1),fmt=110) nz
5433  110 FORMAT (' VALUE OF NZ OUT OF RANGE .. =',i10)
5434  go to 220
5435  120 info(1) = -3
5436  info(2) = nz
5437  130 IF (icntl(1).GT.0) WRITE (icntl(1),fmt=80) info(1)
5438  IF (icntl(1).GT.0) WRITE (icntl(1),fmt=140) liw,info(2)
5439  140 FORMAT (' LIW TOO SMALL, MUST BE INCREASED FROM',i10,' TO',
5440  + ' AT LEAST',i10)
5441  go to 220
5442  150 info(1) = -4
5443  info(2) = nz + n
5444  160 IF (icntl(1).GT.0) WRITE (icntl(1),fmt=80) info(1)
5445  IF (icntl(1).GT.0) WRITE (icntl(1),fmt=170) la,info(2)
5446  170 FORMAT (' LA TOO SMALL, MUST BE INCREASED FROM ',i10,' TO',

5448  go to 220
5449  175 info(1) = -7
5450  IF (icntl(1).GT.0) WRITE (icntl(1),fmt=80) info(1)
5451  IF (icntl(1).GT.0) THEN
5452  WRITE (icntl(1),fmt='(A)') ' NSTEPS is out of range'
5453  END IF
5454  go to 220
5455  180 IF (icntl(1).GT.0) WRITE (icntl(1),fmt=80) info(1)
5456  IF (icntl(1).GT.0) WRITE (icntl(1),fmt=190) info(2)
5457  190 FORMAT (' ZERO PIVOT AT STAGE',i10,
5458  + ' WHEN INPUT MATRIX DECLARED DEFINITE')
5459  go to 220
5460  200 IF (icntl(1).GT.0) WRITE (icntl(1),fmt=80) info(1)
5461  IF (icntl(1).GT.0) WRITE (icntl(1),fmt=210)

5463  + ' WHEN FACTORING ALLEGEDLY DEFINITE MATRIX')
5464  220 IF (icntl(3).LE.0 .OR. icntl(2).LE.0 .OR. info(1).LT.0) go to 310
5465  WRITE (icntl(2),fmt=230) maxfrt,info(1),info(9),info(10),info(12),
5466  + info(13),info(14),info(2)
5467  230 FORMAT (/,' LEAVING MA27BD WITH',
5468  + /,10x,' MAXFRT INFO(1) NRLBDU NIRBDU NCMPBR',
5469  + ' NCMPBI NTWO IERROR',
5470  + /,11x,8i7)
5471  IF (info(1).LT.0) go to 310
5472  kblk = abs(iw(1)+0)
5473  IF (kblk.EQ.0) go to 310
5474  IF (icntl(3).EQ.1) kblk = 1
5475  ipos = 2
5476  iapos = 1
5477  DO 300 iblk = 1,kblk
5478  ncols = iw(ipos)
5479  nrows = iw(ipos+1)
5480  j1 = ipos + 2
5481  IF (ncols.GT.0) go to 240
5482  ncols = -ncols
5483  nrows = 1
5484  j1 = j1 - 1
5485  240 WRITE (icntl(2),fmt=250) iblk,nrows,ncols
5486  250 FORMAT (' BLOCK PIVOT =',i8,' NROWS =',i8,' NCOLS =',i8)
5487  j2 = j1 + ncols - 1
5488  ipos = j2 + 1
5489  WRITE (icntl(2),fmt=260) (iw(jj),jj=j1,j2)
5490  260 FORMAT (' COLUMN INDICES =',10i6,/, (17x,10i6))
5491  WRITE (icntl(2),fmt=270)

5493  len = ncols
5494  DO 290 irows = 1,nrows
5495  j1 = iapos
5496  j2 = iapos + len - 1
5497  WRITE (icntl(2),fmt=280) (a(jj),jj=j1,j2)
5498  280 FORMAT (1p,5d13.3)
5499  len = len - 1
5500  iapos = j2 + 1
5501  290 CONTINUE
5502  300 CONTINUE

5505  SUBROUTINE ma27cd(N,A,LA,IW,LIW,W,MAXFRT,RHS,IW1,NSTEPS,
5506  + icntl,info)

5509  INTEGER iw(liw),iw1(nsteps),icntl(30),info(20)
5510  INTEGER i,iapos,iblk,ipos,irows,j1,j2,jj,k,kblk,latop,len,nblk,
5511  + ncols,nrows
5512  EXTERNAL ma27qd,ma27rd
5513  INTRINSIC abs,min
5514  info(1) = 0
5515  IF (icntl(3).LE.0 .OR. icntl(2).LE.0) go to 110
5516  WRITE (icntl(2),fmt=10) n,la,liw,maxfrt,nsteps
5517  10 FORMAT (/,/,' ENTERING MA27CD WITH N LA LIW MAXFRT',
5518  + ' NSTEPS',/,21x,5i7)
5519  kblk = abs(iw(1)+0)
5520  IF (kblk.EQ.0) go to 90
5521  IF (icntl(3).EQ.1) kblk = 1
5522  ipos = 2
5523  iapos = 1
5524  DO 80 iblk = 1,kblk
5525  ncols = iw(ipos)
5526  nrows = iw(ipos+1)
5527  j1 = ipos + 2
5528  IF (ncols.GT.0) go to 20
5529  ncols = -ncols
5530  nrows = 1
5531  j1 = j1 - 1
5532  20 WRITE (icntl(2),fmt=30) iblk,nrows,ncols

5534  j2 = j1 + ncols - 1
5535  ipos = j2 + 1
5536  WRITE (icntl(2),fmt=40) (iw(jj),jj=j1,j2)
5537  40 FORMAT (' COLUMN INDICES =',10i6,/, (17x,10i6))
5538  WRITE (icntl(2),fmt=50)

5540  len = ncols

5542  j1 = iapos
5543  j2 = iapos + len - 1
5544  WRITE (icntl(2),fmt=60) (a(jj),jj=j1,j2)

5546  len = len - 1
5547  iapos = j2 + 1
5548  70 CONTINUE
5549  80 CONTINUE
5550  90 k = min(10,n)
5551  IF (icntl(3).GT.1) k = n
5552  IF (n.GT.0) WRITE (icntl(2),fmt=100) (rhs(i),i=1,k)
5553  100 FORMAT (' RHS',1p,5d13.3,/, (4x,1p,5d13.3))
5554  110 IF (iw(1).LT.0) go to 130
5555  nblk = iw(1)
5556  IF (nblk.GT.0) go to 140
5557  DO 120 i = 1,n
5558  rhs(i) = 0.0d0
5559  120 CONTINUE
5560  go to 150
5561  130 nblk = -iw(1)
5562  140 CALL ma27qd(n,a,la,iw(2),liw-1,w,maxfrt,rhs,iw1,nblk,latop,icntl)
5563  CALL ma27rd(n,a,la,iw(2),liw-1,w,maxfrt,rhs,iw1,nblk,latop,icntl)
5564  150 IF (icntl(3).LE.0 .OR. icntl(2).LE.0) go to 170
5565  WRITE (icntl(2),fmt=160)
5566  160 FORMAT (/,/,' LEAVING MA27CD WITH')

5568  170 CONTINUE
5569  RETURN
5570  END
5571  SUBROUTINE ma27gd(N,NZ,IRN,ICN,IW,LW,IPE,IQ,FLAG,IWFR,
5572  + icntl,info)
5573  INTEGER iwfr,lw,n,nz
5574  INTEGER flag(n),icn(*),ipe(n),iq(n),irn(*),iw(lw)
5575  INTEGER icntl(*),info(20)
5576  INTEGER i,id,j,jn,k,k1,k2,l,last,lr,n1,ndup
5577  info(2) = 0
5578  DO 10 i = 1,n
5579  ipe(i) = 0
5580  10 CONTINUE
5581  lr = nz
5582  IF (nz.EQ.0) go to 120
5583  DO 110 k = 1,nz
5584  i = irn(k)
5585  j = icn(k)
5586  IF (i.LT.j) THEN
5587  IF (i.GE.1 .AND. j.LE.n) go to 90
5588  ELSE IF (i.GT.j) THEN
5589  IF (j.GE.1 .AND. i.LE.n) go to 90
5590  ELSE
5591  IF (i.GE.1 .AND. i.LE.n) go to 80
5592  END IF
5593  info(2) = info(2) + 1
5594  info(1) = 1
5595  IF (info(2).LE.1 .AND. icntl(2).GT.0) THEN
5596  WRITE (icntl(2),fmt=60) info(1)
5597  END IF
5598  60 FORMAT (' *** WARNING MESSAGE FROM SUBROUTINE MA27AD',
5599  + ' *** INFO(1) =',i2)
5600  IF (info(2).LE.10 .AND. icntl(2).GT.0) THEN
5601  WRITE (icntl(2),fmt=70) k,i,j
5602  END IF
5603  70 FORMAT (i6,'TH NON-ZERO (IN ROW',i6,' AND COLUMN',i6,
5604  + ') IGNORED')
5605  80 i = 0
5606  j = 0
5607  go to 100
5608  90 ipe(i) = ipe(i) + 1
5609  ipe(j) = ipe(j) + 1
5610  100 iw(k) = j
5611  lr = lr + 1
5612  iw(lr) = i
5613  110 CONTINUE
5614  120 iq(1) = 1
5615  n1 = n - 1
5616  IF (n1.LE.0) go to 140
5617  DO 130 i = 1,n1
5618  flag(i) = 0
5619  IF (ipe(i).EQ.0) ipe(i) = -1
5620  iq(i+1) = ipe(i) + iq(i) + 1
5621  ipe(i) = iq(i)
5622  130 CONTINUE
5623  140 last = ipe(n) + iq(n)
5624  flag(n) = 0
5625  IF (lr.GE.last) go to 160
5626  k1 = lr + 1
5627  DO 150 k = k1,last
5628  iw(k) = 0
5629  150 CONTINUE
5630  160 ipe(n) = iq(n)
5631  iwfr = last + 1
5632  IF (nz.EQ.0) go to 230
5633  DO 220 k = 1,nz
5634  j = iw(k)
5635  IF (j.LE.0) go to 220
5636  l = k
5637  iw(k) = 0
5638  DO 210 id = 1,nz
5639  IF (l.GT.nz) go to 170
5640  l = l + nz
5641  go to 180
5642  170 l = l - nz
5643  180 i = iw(l)
5644  iw(l) = 0
5645  IF (i.LT.j) go to 190
5646  l = iq(j) + 1
5647  iq(j) = l
5648  jn = iw(l)
5649  iw(l) = -i
5650  go to 200
5651  190 l = iq(i) + 1
5652  iq(i) = l
5653  jn = iw(l)
5654  iw(l) = -j
5655  200 j = jn
5656  IF (j.LE.0) go to 220
5657  210 CONTINUE
5658  220 CONTINUE
5659  230 ndup = 0
5660  DO 280 i = 1,n
5661  k1 = ipe(i) + 1
5662  k2 = iq(i)
5663  IF (k1.LE.k2) go to 240
5664  ipe(i) = 0
5665  iq(i) = 0
5666  go to 280
5667  240 DO 260 k = k1,k2
5668  j = -iw(k)
5669  IF (j.LE.0) go to 270
5670  l = iq(j) + 1
5671  iq(j) = l
5672  iw(l) = i
5673  iw(k) = j
5674  IF (flag(j).NE.i) go to 250
5675  ndup = ndup + 1
5676  iw(l) = 0
5677  iw(k) = 0
5678  250 flag(j) = i
5679  260 CONTINUE
5680  270 iq(i) = iq(i) - ipe(i)
5681  IF (ndup.EQ.0) iw(k1-1) = iq(i)
5682  280 CONTINUE
5683  IF (ndup.EQ.0) go to 310
5684  iwfr = 1
5685  DO 300 i = 1,n
5686  k1 = ipe(i) + 1
5687  IF (k1.EQ.1) go to 300
5688  k2 = iq(i) + ipe(i)
5689  l = iwfr
5690  ipe(i) = iwfr
5691  iwfr = iwfr + 1
5692  DO 290 k = k1,k2
5693  IF (iw(k).EQ.0) go to 290
5694  iw(iwfr) = iw(k)
5695  iwfr = iwfr + 1
5696  290 CONTINUE
5697  iw(l) = iwfr - l - 1
5698  300 CONTINUE
5699  310 RETURN
5700  END
5701  SUBROUTINE ma27hd(N,IPE,IW,LW,IWFR,NV,NXT,LST,IPD,FLAG,IOVFLO,
5702  + ncmpa,fratio)
5703  DOUBLE PRECISION fratio
5704  INTEGER iwfr,lw,n,iovflo,ncmpa
5705  INTEGER flag(n),ipd(n),ipe(n),iw(lw),lst(n),nv(n),nxt(n)
5706  INTEGER i,id,idl,idn,ie,ip,is,jp,jp1,jp2,js,k,k1,k2,ke,kp,kp0,kp1,
5707  + kp2,ks,l,len,limit,ln,ls,lwfr,md,me,ml,ms,nel,nflg,np,
5708  + np0,ns,nvpiv,nvroot,root
5709  EXTERNAL ma27ud
5710  INTRINSIC abs,min
5711  DO 10 i = 1,n
5712  ipd(i) = 0
5713  nv(i) = 1
5714  flag(i) = iovflo
5715  10 CONTINUE
5716  md = 1
5717  ncmpa = 0
5718  nflg = iovflo
5719  nel = 0
5720  root = n+1
5721  nvroot = 0
5722  DO 30 is = 1,n
5723  k = ipe(is)
5724  IF (k.LE.0) go to 20
5725  id = iw(k) + 1
5726  ns = ipd(id)
5727  IF (ns.GT.0) lst(ns) = is
5728  nxt(is) = ns
5729  ipd(id) = is
5730  lst(is) = -id
5731  go to 30
5732  20 nel = nel + 1
5733  flag(is) = -1
5734  nxt(is) = 0
5735  lst(is) = 0
5736  30 CONTINUE
5737  DO 340 ml = 1,n
5738  IF (nel+nvroot+1.GE.n) go to 350
5739  DO 40 id = md,n
5740  ms = ipd(id)
5741  IF (ms.GT.0) go to 50
5742  40 CONTINUE
5743  50 md = id
5744  nvpiv = nv(ms)
5745  ns = nxt(ms)
5746  nxt(ms) = 0
5747  lst(ms) = 0
5748  IF (ns.GT.0) lst(ns) = -id
5749  ipd(id) = ns
5750  me = ms
5751  nel = nel + nvpiv
5752  idn = 0
5753  kp = ipe(me)
5754  flag(ms) = -1
5755  ip = iwfr
5756  len = iw(kp)
5757  DO 140 kp1 = 1,len
5758  kp = kp + 1
5759  ke = iw(kp)
5760  IF (flag(ke).LE.-2) go to 60
5761  IF (flag(ke).LE.0) THEN
5762  IF (ipe(ke).NE.-root) go to 140
5763  ke = root
5764  IF (flag(ke).LE.0) go to 140
5765  END IF
5766  jp = kp - 1
5767  ln = len - kp1 + 1
5768  ie = ms
5769  go to 70
5770  60 ie = ke
5771  jp = ipe(ie)
5772  ln = iw(jp)
5773  70 DO 130 jp1 = 1,ln
5774  jp = jp + 1
5775  is = iw(jp)
5776  IF (flag(is).LE.0) THEN
5777  IF (ipe(is).EQ.-root) THEN
5778  is = root
5779  iw(jp) = root
5780  IF (flag(is).LE.0) go to 130
5781  ELSE
5782  go to 130
5783  END IF
5784  END IF
5785  flag(is) = 0
5786  IF (iwfr.LT.lw) go to 100
5787  ipe(ms) = kp
5788  iw(kp) = len - kp1
5789  ipe(ie) = jp
5790  iw(jp) = ln - jp1
5791  CALL ma27ud(n,ipe,iw,ip-1,lwfr,ncmpa)
5792  jp2 = iwfr - 1
5793  iwfr = lwfr
5794  IF (ip.GT.jp2) go to 90
5795  DO 80 jp = ip,jp2
5796  iw(iwfr) = iw(jp)
5797  iwfr = iwfr + 1
5798  80 CONTINUE
5799  90 ip = lwfr
5800  jp = ipe(ie)
5801  kp = ipe(me)
5802  100 iw(iwfr) = is
5803  idn = idn + nv(is)
5804  iwfr = iwfr + 1
5805  ls = lst(is)
5806  lst(is) = 0
5807  ns = nxt(is)
5808  nxt(is) = 0
5809  IF (ns.GT.0) lst(ns) = ls
5810  IF (ls.LT.0) THEN
5811  ls = -ls
5812  ipd(ls) = ns
5813  ELSE IF (ls.GT.0) THEN
5814  nxt(ls) = ns
5815  END IF
5816  130 CONTINUE
5817  IF (ie.EQ.ms) go to 150
5818  ipe(ie) = -me
5819  flag(ie) = -1
5820  140 CONTINUE
5821  150 nv(ms) = idn + nvpiv
5822  IF (iwfr.EQ.ip) go to 330
5823  k1 = ip
5824  k2 = iwfr - 1
5825  limit = nint(fratio*(n-nel))
5826  DO 310 k = k1,k2
5827  is = iw(k)
5828  IF (is.EQ.root) go to 310
5829  IF (nflg.GT.2) go to 170
5830  DO 160 i = 1,n
5831  IF (flag(i).GT.0) flag(i) = iovflo
5832  IF (flag(i).LE.-2) flag(i) = -iovflo
5833  160 CONTINUE
5834  nflg = iovflo
5835  170 nflg = nflg - 1
5836  id = idn
5837  kp1 = ipe(is) + 1
5838  np = kp1
5839  kp2 = iw(kp1-1) + kp1 - 1
5840  DO 220 kp = kp1,kp2
5841  ke = iw(kp)
5842  IF (flag(ke).EQ.-1) THEN
5843  IF (ipe(ke).NE.-root) go to 220
5844  ke = root
5845  iw(kp) = root
5846  IF (flag(ke).EQ.-1) go to 220
5847  END IF
5848  IF (flag(ke).GE.0) go to 230
5849  jp1 = ipe(ke) + 1
5850  jp2 = iw(jp1-1) + jp1 - 1
5851  idl = id

5853  js = iw(jp)

5858  IF (id.GT.idl) go to 210
5859  DO 200 jp = jp1,jp2
5860  js = iw(jp)
5861  IF (flag(js).NE.0) go to 210
5862  200 CONTINUE
5863  ipe(ke) = -me
5864  flag(ke) = -1
5865  go to 220
5866  210 iw(np) = ke
5867  flag(ke) = -nflg
5868  np = np + 1
5869  220 CONTINUE
5870  np0 = np
5871  go to 250
5872  230 kp0 = kp
5873  np0 = np
5874  DO 240 kp = kp0,kp2
5875  ks = iw(kp)
5876  IF (flag(ks).LE.nflg) THEN
5877  IF (ipe(ks).EQ.-root) THEN
5878  ks = root
5879  iw(kp) = root
5880  IF (flag(ks).LE.nflg) go to 240
5881  ELSE
5882  go to 240
5883  END IF
5884  END IF
5885  id = id + nv(ks)
5886  flag(ks) = nflg
5887  iw(np) = ks
5888  np = np + 1
5889  240 CONTINUE
5890  250 IF (id.GE.limit) go to 295
5891  iw(np) = iw(np0)
5892  iw(np0) = iw(kp1)
5893  iw(kp1) = me
5894  iw(kp1-1) = np - kp1 + 1
5895  js = ipd(id)
5896  DO 280 l = 1,n
5897  IF (js.LE.0) go to 300
5898  kp1 = ipe(js) + 1
5899  IF (iw(kp1).NE.me) go to 300
5900  kp2 = kp1 - 1 + iw(kp1-1)
5901  DO 260 kp = kp1,kp2
5902  ie = iw(kp)
5903  IF (abs(flag(ie)+0).GT.nflg) go to 270
5904  260 CONTINUE
5905  go to 290
5906  270 js = nxt(js)
5907  280 CONTINUE
5908  290 ipe(js) = -is
5909  nv(is) = nv(is) + nv(js)
5910  nv(js) = 0
5911  flag(js) = -1
5912  ns = nxt(js)
5913  ls = lst(js)
5914  IF (ns.GT.0) lst(ns) = is
5915  IF (ls.GT.0) nxt(ls) = is
5916  lst(is) = ls
5917  nxt(is) = ns
5918  lst(js) = 0
5919  nxt(js) = 0
5920  IF (ipd(id).EQ.js) ipd(id) = is
5921  go to 310
5922  295 IF (nvroot.EQ.0) THEN
5923  root = is
5924  ipe(is) = 0
5925  ELSE
5926  iw(k) = root
5927  ipe(is) = -root
5928  nv(root) = nv(root) + nv(is)
5929  nv(is) = 0
5930  flag(is) = -1
5931  END IF
5932  nvroot = nv(root)
5933  go to 310
5934  300 ns = ipd(id)
5935  IF (ns.GT.0) lst(ns) = is
5936  nxt(is) = ns
5937  ipd(id) = is
5938  lst(is) = -id
5939  md = min(md,id)
5940  310 CONTINUE
5941  DO 320 k = k1,k2
5942  is = iw(k)
5943  IF (nv(is).EQ.0) go to 320
5944  flag(is) = nflg
5945  iw(ip) = is
5946  ip = ip + 1
5947  320 CONTINUE
5948  iwfr = k1
5949  flag(me) = -nflg
5950  iw(ip) = iw(k1)
5951  iw(k1) = ip - k1
5952  ipe(me) = k1
5953  iwfr = ip + 1
5954  go to 335
5955  330 ipe(me) = 0
5956  335 CONTINUE
5957  340 CONTINUE
5958  350 DO 360 is = 1,n
5959  IF(nxt(is).NE.0 .OR. lst(is).NE.0) THEN
5960  IF (nvroot.EQ.0) THEN
5961  root = is
5962  ipe(is) = 0
5963  ELSE
5964  ipe(is) = -root
5965  END IF
5966  nvroot = nvroot + nv(is)
5967  nv(is) = 0
5968  END IF
5969  360 CONTINUE
5970  DO 370 ie = 1,n
5971  IF (ipe(ie).GT.0) ipe(ie) = -root
5972  370 CONTINUE
5973  IF(nvroot.GT.0)nv(root)=nvroot
5974  END
5975  SUBROUTINE ma27ud(N,IPE,IW,LW,IWFR,NCMPA)
5976  INTEGER iwfr,lw,n,ncmpa

5979  ncmpa = ncmpa + 1
5980  DO 10 i = 1,n

5982  IF (k1.LE.0) go to 10
5983  ipe(i) = iw(k1)
5984  iw(k1) = -i
5985  10 CONTINUE
5986  iwfr = 1
5987  lwfr = iwfr
5988  DO 60 ir = 1,n
5989  IF (lwfr.GT.lw) go to 70
5990  DO 20 k = lwfr,lw
5991  IF (iw(k).LT.0) go to 30
5992  20 CONTINUE
5993  go to 70
5994  30 i = -iw(k)
5995  iw(iwfr) = ipe(i)
5996  ipe(i) = iwfr
5997  k1 = k + 1
5998  k2 = k + iw(iwfr)
5999  iwfr = iwfr + 1
6000  IF (k1.GT.k2) go to 50
6001  DO 40 k = k1,k2
6002  iw(iwfr) = iw(k)
6003  iwfr = iwfr + 1
6004  40 CONTINUE
6005  50 lwfr = k2 + 1
6006  60 CONTINUE
6007  70 RETURN
6008  END
6009  SUBROUTINE ma27jd(N,NZ,IRN,ICN,PERM,IW,LW,IPE,IQ,FLAG,IWFR,
6010  + icntl,info)
6011  INTEGER iwfr,lw,n,nz
6012  INTEGER flag(n),icn(*),ipe(n),iq(n),irn(*),iw(lw),perm(n)
6013  INTEGER icntl(30),info(20)
6014  INTEGER i,id,in,j,jdummy,k,k1,k2,l,lbig,len
6015  INTRINSIC max
6016  info(1) = 0
6017  info(2) = 0
6018  DO 10 i = 1,n
6019  iq(i) = 0
6020  10 CONTINUE
6021  IF (nz.EQ.0) go to 110
6022  DO 100 k = 1,nz
6023  i = irn(k)
6024  j = icn(k)
6025  iw(k) = -i
6026  IF(i.LT.j) THEN
6027  IF (i.GE.1 .AND. j.LE.n) go to 80
6028  ELSE IF(i.GT.j) THEN
6029  IF (j.GE.1 .AND. i.LE.n) go to 80
6030  ELSE
6031  iw(k) = 0
6032  IF (i.GE.1 .AND. i.LE.n) go to 100
6033  END IF
6034  info(2) = info(2) + 1
6035  info(1) = 1
6036  iw(k) = 0
6037  IF (info(2).LE.1 .AND. icntl(2).GT.0) THEN
6038  WRITE (icntl(2),fmt=60) info(1)
6039  END IF
6040  60 FORMAT (' *** WARNING MESSAGE FROM SUBROUTINE MA27AD',
6041  + ' *** INFO(1) =',i2)
6042  IF (info(2).LE.10 .AND. icntl(2).GT.0) THEN
6043  WRITE (icntl(2),fmt=70) k,i,j
6044  END IF
6045  70 FORMAT (i6,'TH NON-ZERO (IN ROW',i6,' AND COLUMN',i6,
6046  + ') IGNORED')
6047  go to 100
6048  80 IF (perm(j).GT.perm(i)) go to 90
6049  iq(j) = iq(j) + 1
6050  go to 100
6051  90 iq(i) = iq(i) + 1
6052  100 CONTINUE
6053  110 iwfr = 1
6054  lbig = 0
6055  DO 120 i = 1,n
6056  l = iq(i)
6057  lbig = max(l,lbig)
6058  iwfr = iwfr + l
6059  ipe(i) = iwfr - 1
6060  120 CONTINUE
6061  IF (nz.EQ.0) go to 250
6062  DO 160 k = 1,nz
6063  i = -iw(k)
6064  IF (i.LE.0) go to 160
6065  l = k
6066  iw(k) = 0
6067  DO 150 id = 1,nz
6068  j = icn(l)
6069  IF (perm(i).LT.perm(j)) go to 130
6070  l = ipe(j)
6071  ipe(j) = l - 1
6072  in = iw(l)
6073  iw(l) = i
6074  go to 140
6075  130 l = ipe(i)
6076  ipe(i) = l - 1
6077  in = iw(l)
6078  iw(l) = j
6079  140 i = -in
6080  IF (i.LE.0) go to 160
6081  150 CONTINUE
6082  160 CONTINUE
6083  k = iwfr - 1
6084  l = k + n
6085  iwfr = l + 1
6086  DO 190 i = 1,n
6087  flag(i) = 0
6088  j = n + 1 - i
6089  len = iq(j)
6090  IF (len.LE.0) go to 180
6091  DO 170 jdummy = 1,len
6092  iw(l) = iw(k)
6093  k = k - 1
6094  l = l - 1
6095  170 CONTINUE
6096  180 ipe(j) = l
6097  l = l - 1
6098  190 CONTINUE
6099  IF (lbig.GE.icntl(4)) go to 210
6100  DO 200 i = 1,n
6101  k = ipe(i)
6102  iw(k) = iq(i)
6103  IF (iq(i).EQ.0) ipe(i) = 0
6104  200 CONTINUE
6105  go to 250
6106  210 iwfr = 1
6107  DO 240 i = 1,n
6108  k1 = ipe(i) + 1
6109  k2 = ipe(i) + iq(i)
6110  IF (k1.LE.k2) go to 220
6111  ipe(i) = 0
6112  go to 240
6113  220 ipe(i) = iwfr
6114  iwfr = iwfr + 1
6115  DO 230 k = k1,k2
6116  j = iw(k)
6117  IF (flag(j).EQ.i) go to 230
6118  iw(iwfr) = j
6119  iwfr = iwfr + 1
6120  flag(j) = i
6121  230 CONTINUE
6122  k = ipe(i)
6123  iw(k) = iwfr - k - 1
6124  240 CONTINUE
6125  250 RETURN
6126  END
6127  SUBROUTINE ma27kd(N,IPE,IW,LW,IWFR,IPS,IPV,NV,FLAG,NCMPA)
6128  INTEGER iwfr,lw,n,ncmpa
6129  INTEGER flag(n),ipe(n),ips(n),ipv(n),iw(lw),nv(n)
6130  INTEGER i,ie,ip,j,je,jp,jp1,jp2,js,kdummy,ln,lwfr,me,minjs,ml,ms

6132  INTRINSIC min

6135  nv(i) = 0
6136  j = ips(i)
6137  ipv(j) = i
6138  10 CONTINUE
6139  ncmpa = 0
6140  DO 100 ml = 1,n
6141  ms = ipv(ml)
6142  me = ms

6144  ip = iwfr
6145  minjs = n
6146  ie = me
6147  DO 70 kdummy = 1,n

6149  ln = 0

6151  ln = iw(jp)
6152  DO 50 jp1 = 1,ln
6153  jp = jp + 1
6154  js = iw(jp)
6155  IF (flag(js).EQ.me) go to 50

6157  IF (iwfr.LT.lw) go to 40
6158  ipe(ie) = jp
6159  iw(jp) = ln - jp1
6160  CALL ma27ud(n,ipe,iw,ip-1,lwfr,ncmpa)
6161  jp2 = iwfr - 1
6162  iwfr = lwfr
6163  IF (ip.GT.jp2) go to 30
6164  DO 20 jp = ip,jp2
6165  iw(iwfr) = iw(jp)
6166  iwfr = iwfr + 1
6167  20 CONTINUE
6168  30 ip = lwfr
6169  jp = ipe(ie)
6170  40 iw(iwfr) = js
6171  minjs = min(minjs,ips(js)+0)
6172  iwfr = iwfr + 1
6173  50 CONTINUE
6174  60 ipe(ie) = -me
6175  je = nv(ie)
6176  nv(ie) = ln + 1
6177  ie = je
6178  IF (ie.EQ.0) go to 80
6179  70 CONTINUE
6180  80 IF (iwfr.GT.ip) go to 90
6181  ipe(me) = 0
6182  nv(me) = 1
6183  go to 100
6184  90 minjs = ipv(minjs)
6185  nv(me) = nv(minjs)
6186  nv(minjs) = me
6187  iw(iwfr) = iw(ip)
6188  iw(ip) = iwfr - ip

6194  SUBROUTINE ma27ld(N,IPE,NV,IPS,NE,NA,ND,NSTEPS,NEMIN)
6195  INTEGER n,nsteps,nemin
6196  INTEGER ipe(n),ips(n),na(n),nd(n),ne(n),nv(n)
6197  INTEGER i,ib,if,il,is,ison,k,l,nr
6198  DO 10 i = 1,n
6199  ips(i) = 0
6200  ne(i) = 0
6201  10 CONTINUE
6202  DO 20 i = 1,n
6203  IF (nv(i).GT.0) go to 20
6204  IF = -ipe(i)
6205  is = -ips(if)
6206  IF (is.GT.0) ipe(i) = is
6207  ips(if) = -i
6208  20 CONTINUE
6209  nr = n + 1
6210  DO 50 i = 1,n
6211  IF (nv(i).LE.0) go to 50
6212  IF = -ipe(i)
6213  IF (if.EQ.0) go to 40
6214  is = -ips(if)
6215  IF (is.LE.0) go to 30
6216  ipe(i) = is
6217  30 ips(if) = -i
6218  go to 50
6219  40 nr = nr - 1
6220  ne(nr) = i
6221  50 CONTINUE
6222  is = 1
6223  i = 0
6224  DO 160 k = 1,n
6225  IF (i.GT.0) go to 60
6226  i = ne(nr)
6227  ne(nr) = 0
6228  nr = nr + 1
6229  il = n
6230  na(n) = 0
6231  60 DO 70 l = 1,n
6232  IF (ips(i).GE.0) go to 80
6233  ison = -ips(i)
6234  ips(i) = 0
6235  i = ison
6236  il = il - 1
6237  na(il) = 0
6238  70 CONTINUE
6239  80 ips(i) = k
6240  ne(is) = ne(is) + 1
6241  IF (nv(i).LE.0) go to 120
6242  IF (il.LT.n) na(il+1) = na(il+1) + 1
6243  na(is) = na(il)
6244  nd(is) = nv(i)
6245  IF (na(is).NE.1) go to 90
6246  IF (nd(is-1)-ne(is-1).EQ.nd(is)) go to 100
6247  90 IF (ne(is).GE.nemin) go to 110
6248  IF (na(is).EQ.0) go to 110
6249  IF (ne(is-1).GE.nemin) go to 110
6250  100 na(is-1) = na(is-1) + na(is) - 1
6251  nd(is-1) = nd(is) + ne(is-1)
6252  ne(is-1) = ne(is) + ne(is-1)
6253  ne(is) = 0
6254  go to 120
6255  110 is = is + 1
6256  120 ib = ipe(i)
6257  IF (ib.GE.0) THEN
6258  IF (ib.GT.0) na(il) = 0
6259  i = ib
6260  ELSE
6261  i = -ib
6262  il = il + 1
6263  END IF
6264  160 CONTINUE
6265  nsteps = is - 1
6266  RETURN
6267  END
6268  SUBROUTINE ma27md(N,NZ,IRN,ICN,PERM,NA,NE,ND,NSTEPS,LSTKI,LSTKR,
6269  + iw,info,ops)
6270  DOUBLE PRECISION ops
6271  INTEGER n,nsteps,nz
6272  INTEGER icn(*),irn(*),iw(*),lstki(n),lstkr(n),na(nsteps),
6273  + nd(nsteps),ne(nsteps),perm(n),info(20)
6274  INTEGER i,inew,iold,iorg,irow,istki,istkr,itop,itree,jold,jorg,k,
6275  + lstk,nassr,nelim,nfr,nstk,numorg,nz1,nz2
6276  DOUBLE PRECISION delim
6277  INTEGER nrladu,niradu,nirtot,nrltot,nirnec,nrlnec
6278  INTRINSIC max,min
6279  IF (nz.EQ.0) go to 20
6280  IF (irn(1).NE.iw(1)) go to 20
6281  irn(1) = iw(1) - 1
6282  nz2 = 0
6283  DO 10 iold = 1,n
6284  inew = perm(iold)
6285  lstki(inew) = lstkr(iold) + 1
6286  nz2 = nz2 + lstkr(iold)
6287  10 CONTINUE
6288  nz1 = nz2/2 + n
6289  nz2 = nz2 + n
6290  go to 60
6291  20 DO 30 i = 1,n
6292  lstki(i) = 1
6293  30 CONTINUE
6294  nz1 = n
6295  IF (nz.EQ.0) go to 50
6296  DO 40 i = 1,nz
6297  iold = irn(i)
6298  jold = icn(i)
6299  IF (iold.LT.1 .OR. iold.GT.n) go to 40
6300  IF (jold.LT.1 .OR. jold.GT.n) go to 40
6301  IF (iold.EQ.jold) go to 40
6302  nz1 = nz1 + 1
6303  irow = min(perm(iold)+0,perm(jold)+0)
6304  lstki(irow) = lstki(irow) + 1
6305  40 CONTINUE
6306  50 nz2 = nz1
6307  60 istki = 0
6308  istkr = 0
6309  ops = 0.0d0
6310  nrladu = 0
6311  niradu = 1
6312  nirtot = nz1
6313  nrltot = nz1
6314  nirnec = nz2
6315  nrlnec = nz2
6316  numorg = 0
6317  itop = 0
6318  DO 100 itree = 1,nsteps
6319  nelim = ne(itree)
6320  delim = nelim
6321  nfr = nd(itree)
6322  nstk = na(itree)
6323  nassr = nfr* (nfr+1)/2
6324  IF (nstk.NE.0) nassr = nassr - lstkr(itop) + 1
6325  nrltot = max(nrltot,nrladu+nassr+istkr+nz1)
6326  nirtot = max(nirtot,niradu+nfr+2+istki+nz1)
6327  nrlnec = max(nrlnec,nrladu+nassr+istkr+nz2)
6328  nirnec = max(nirnec,niradu+nfr+2+istki+nz2)
6329  DO 70 iorg = 1,nelim
6330  jorg = numorg + iorg
6331  nz2 = nz2 - lstki(jorg)
6332  70 CONTINUE
6333  numorg = numorg + nelim
6334  IF (nstk.LE.0) go to 90
6335  DO 80 k = 1,nstk
6336  lstk = lstkr(itop)
6337  istkr = istkr - lstk
6338  lstk = lstki(itop)
6339  istki = istki - lstk
6340  itop = itop - 1
6341  80 CONTINUE
6342  90 nrladu = nrladu + (nelim* (2*nfr-nelim+1))/2
6343  niradu = niradu + 2 + nfr
6344  IF (nelim.EQ.1) niradu = niradu - 1
6345  ops = ops + ((nfr*delim*(nfr+1)-(2*nfr+1)*delim*(delim+1)/2+
6346  + delim* (delim+1)* (2*delim+1)/6)/2)
6347  IF (itree.EQ.nsteps) go to 100
6348  IF (nfr.EQ.nelim) go to 100
6349  itop = itop + 1
6350  lstkr(itop) = (nfr-nelim)* (nfr-nelim+1)/2
6351  lstki(itop) = nfr - nelim + 1
6352  istki = istki + lstki(itop)
6353  istkr = istkr + lstkr(itop)
6354  nirtot = max(nirtot,niradu+istki+nz1)
6355  nirnec = max(nirnec,niradu+istki+nz2)
6356  100 CONTINUE
6357  nrlnec = max(nrlnec,n+max(nz,nz1))
6358  nrltot = max(nrltot,n+max(nz,nz1))
6359  nrlnec = min(nrlnec,nrltot)
6360  nirnec = max(nz,nirnec)
6361  nirtot = max(nz,nirtot)
6362  nirnec = min(nirnec,nirtot)
6363  info(3) = nrltot
6364  info(4) = nirtot
6365  info(5) = nrlnec
6366  info(6) = nirnec
6367  info(7) = nrladu
6368  info(8) = niradu
6369  RETURN
6370  END
6371  SUBROUTINE ma27nd(N,NZ,NZ1,A,LA,IRN,ICN,IW,LIW,PERM,IW2,ICNTL,
6372  + info)
6373  DOUBLE PRECISION zero
6374  parameter(zero=0.0d0)
6375  INTEGER la,liw,n,nz,nz1
6376  DOUBLE PRECISION a(la)
6377  INTEGER icn(*),irn(*),iw(liw),iw2(n),perm(n),icntl(30),info(20)
6378  DOUBLE PRECISION anext,anow
6379  INTEGER i,ia,ich,ii,iiw,inew,iold,ipos,j1,j2,jj,jnew,jold,jpos,k
6380  INTRINSIC min
6381  info(1) = 0
6382  ia = la
6383  DO 10 iold = 1,n
6384  iw2(iold) = 1
6385  a(ia) = zero
6386  ia = ia - 1
6387  10 CONTINUE
6388  info(2) = 0
6389  nz1 = n
6390  IF (nz.EQ.0) go to 80
6391  DO 70 k = 1,nz
6392  iold = irn(k)
6393  IF (iold.GT.n .OR. iold.LE.0) go to 30
6394  jold = icn(k)
6395  IF (jold.GT.n .OR. jold.LE.0) go to 30
6396  inew = perm(iold)
6397  jnew = perm(jold)
6398  IF (inew.NE.jnew) go to 20
6399  ia = la - n + iold
6400  a(ia) = a(ia) + a(k)
6401  go to 60
6402  20 inew = min(inew,jnew)
6403  iw2(inew) = iw2(inew) + 1
6404  iw(k) = -iold
6405  nz1 = nz1 + 1
6406  go to 70
6407  30 info(1) = 1
6408  info(2) = info(2) + 1

6936  735 CONTINUE
6937  740 azero = min(azero,astk-1)
6938  750 IF (npiv.EQ.0) iwpos = ioldps
6939  760 CONTINUE
6940  iw(1) = nblk
6941  IF (ntwo.GT.0) iw(1) = -nblk
6942  nrlbdu = posfac - 1
6943  nirbdu = iwpos - 1
6944  IF (ntotpv.EQ.n) go to 810
6945  info(1) = 3
6946  info(2) = ntotpv
6947  go to 810
6948  770 info(1) = -3
6949  go to 810
6950  780 info(1) = -4
6951  info(2) = la + max(posfac+lnass,apos2-ltopst+2) - astk
6952  go to 810
6953  790 info(1) = -5
6954  info(2) = ntotpv + 1
6955  go to 810
6956  800 info(1) = -6
6957  info(2) = ntotpv + 1
6958  810 CONTINUE
6959  info(9) = nrlbdu
6960  info(10) = nirbdu
6961  info(12) = ncmpbr
6962  info(13) = ncmpbi
6963  info(14) = ntwo
6964  info(15) = neig
6965  RETURN
6966  END
6967  SUBROUTINE ma27pd(A,IW,J1,J2,ITOP,IREAL,NCMPBR,NCMPBI)
6968  INTEGER ireal,itop,j1,j2,ncmpbr,ncmpbi
6969  DOUBLE PRECISION a(*)
6970  INTEGER iw(*)
6971  INTEGER ipos,jj,jjj
6972  ipos = itop - 1
6973  IF (j2.EQ.ipos) go to 50
6974  IF (ireal.EQ.2) go to 20
6975  ncmpbr = ncmpbr + 1
6976  IF (j1.GT.j2) go to 40
6977  DO 10 jjj = j1,j2
6978  jj = j2 - jjj + j1
6979  a(ipos) = a(jj)
6980  ipos = ipos - 1
6981  10 CONTINUE
6982  go to 40
6983  20 ncmpbi = ncmpbi + 1
6984  IF (j1.GT.j2) go to 40
6985  DO 30 jjj = j1,j2
6986  jj = j2 - jjj + j1
6987  iw(ipos) = iw(jj)
6988  ipos = ipos - 1
6989  30 CONTINUE
6990  40 j2 = itop - 1
6991  j1 = ipos + 1
6992  50 RETURN
6993  END
6994  SUBROUTINE ma27qd(N,A,LA,IW,LIW,W,MAXFNT,RHS,IW2,NBLK,LATOP,ICNTL)
6995  INTEGER ifrlvl
6996  parameter( ifrlvl=5 )
6997  INTEGER la,latop,liw,maxfnt,n,nblk
6998  DOUBLE PRECISION a(la),rhs(n),w(maxfnt)
6999  INTEGER iw(liw),iw2(nblk),icntl(30)
7000  DOUBLE PRECISION w1,w2
7001  INTEGER apos,iblk,ifr,ilvl,ipiv,ipos,irhs,irow,ist,j,j1,j2,j3,jj,
7002  + jpiv,k,k1,k2,k3,liell,npiv
7003  INTRINSIC abs,min
7004  apos = 1
7005  ipos = 1
7006  j2 = 0
7007  iblk = 0
7008  npiv = 0
7009  DO 140 irow = 1,n
7010  IF (npiv.GT.0) go to 90
7011  iblk = iblk + 1
7012  IF (iblk.GT.nblk) go to 150
7013  ipos = j2 + 1
7014  iw2(iblk) = ipos
7015  liell = -iw(ipos)
7016  npiv = 1
7017  IF (liell.GT.0) go to 10
7018  liell = -liell
7019  ipos = ipos + 1
7020  npiv = iw(ipos)
7021  10 j1 = ipos + 1
7022  j2 = ipos + liell
7023  ilvl = min(npiv,10)
7024  IF (liell.LT.icntl(ifrlvl+ilvl)) go to 90
7025  ifr = 0
7026  DO 20 jj = j1,j2
7027  j = abs(iw(jj)+0)
7028  ifr = ifr + 1
7029  w(ifr) = rhs(j)
7030  20 CONTINUE
7031  jpiv = 1
7032  j3 = j1
7033  DO 70 ipiv = 1,npiv
7034  jpiv = jpiv - 1
7035  IF (jpiv.EQ.1) go to 70
7036  IF (iw(j3).LT.0) go to 40
7037  jpiv = 1
7038  j3 = j3 + 1
7039  apos = apos + 1
7040  ist = ipiv + 1
7041  IF (liell.LT.ist) go to 70
7042  w1 = w(ipiv)
7043  k = apos
7044  DO 30 j = ist,liell
7045  w(j) = w(j) + a(k)*w1
7046  k = k + 1
7047  30 CONTINUE
7048  apos = apos + liell - ist + 1
7049  go to 70
7050  40 jpiv = 2
7051  j3 = j3 + 2
7052  apos = apos + 2
7053  ist = ipiv + 2
7054  IF (liell.LT.ist) go to 60
7055  w1 = w(ipiv)
7056  w2 = w(ipiv+1)
7057  k1 = apos
7058  k2 = apos + liell - ipiv
7059  DO 50 j = ist,liell
7060  w(j) = w(j) + w1*a(k1) + w2*a(k2)
7061  k1 = k1 + 1
7062  k2 = k2 + 1
7063  50 CONTINUE
7064  60 apos = apos + 2* (liell-ist+1) + 1
7065  70 CONTINUE
7066  ifr = 0
7067  DO 80 jj = j1,j2
7068  j = abs(iw(jj)+0)
7069  ifr = ifr + 1
7070  rhs(j) = w(ifr)
7071  80 CONTINUE
7072  npiv = 0
7073  go to 140
7074  90 IF (iw(j1).LT.0) go to 110
7075  npiv = npiv - 1
7076  apos = apos + 1
7077  j1 = j1 + 1
7078  IF (j1.GT.j2) go to 140
7079  irhs = iw(j1-1)
7080  w1 = rhs(irhs)
7081  k = apos
7082  DO 100 j = j1,j2
7083  irhs = abs(iw(j)+0)
7084  rhs(irhs) = rhs(irhs) + a(k)*w1
7085  k = k + 1
7086  100 CONTINUE
7087  apos = apos + j2 - j1 + 1
7088  go to 140
7089  110 npiv = npiv - 2
7090  j1 = j1 + 2
7091  apos = apos + 2
7092  IF (j1.GT.j2) go to 130
7093  irhs = -iw(j1-2)
7094  w1 = rhs(irhs)
7095  irhs = iw(j1-1)
7096  w2 = rhs(irhs)
7097  k1 = apos
7098  k3 = apos + j2 - j1 + 2
7099  DO 120 j = j1,j2
7100  irhs = abs(iw(j)+0)
7101  rhs(irhs) = rhs(irhs) + w1*a(k1) + w2*a(k3)
7102  k1 = k1 + 1
7103  k3 = k3 + 1
7104  120 CONTINUE
7105  130 apos = apos + 2* (j2-j1+1) + 1
7106  140 CONTINUE
7107  150 latop = apos - 1
7108  RETURN
7109  END
7110  SUBROUTINE ma27rd(N,A,LA,IW,LIW,W,MAXFNT,RHS,IW2,NBLK,LATOP,ICNTL)
7111  INTEGER ifrlvl
7112  parameter( ifrlvl=5 )
7113  INTEGER la,latop,liw,maxfnt,n,nblk
7114  DOUBLE PRECISION a(la),rhs(n),w(maxfnt)
7115  INTEGER iw(liw),iw2(nblk),icntl(30)
7116  DOUBLE PRECISION w1,w2
7117  INTEGER apos,apos2,i1rhs,i2rhs,iblk,ifr,iipiv,iirhs,ilvl,ipiv,
7118  + ipos,irhs,ist,j,j1,j2,jj,jj1,jj2,jpiv,jpos,k,liell,loop,
7119  + npiv
7120  INTRINSIC abs,min
7121  apos = latop + 1
7122  npiv = 0
7123  iblk = nblk + 1
7124  DO 180 loop = 1,n
7125  IF (npiv.GT.0) go to 110
7126  iblk = iblk - 1
7127  IF (iblk.LT.1) go to 190
7128  ipos = iw2(iblk)
7129  liell = -iw(ipos)
7130  npiv = 1
7131  IF (liell.GT.0) go to 10
7132  liell = -liell
7133  ipos = ipos + 1
7134  npiv = iw(ipos)
7135  10 jpos = ipos + npiv
7136  j2 = ipos + liell
7137  ilvl = min(10,npiv) + 10
7138  IF (liell.LT.icntl(ifrlvl+ilvl)) go to 110
7139  j1 = ipos + 1
7140  ifr = 0
7141  DO 20 jj = j1,j2
7142  j = abs(iw(jj)+0)
7143  ifr = ifr + 1
7144  w(ifr) = rhs(j)
7145  20 CONTINUE
7146  jpiv = 1
7147  DO 90 iipiv = 1,npiv
7148  jpiv = jpiv - 1
7149  IF (jpiv.EQ.1) go to 90
7150  ipiv = npiv - iipiv + 1
7151  IF (ipiv.EQ.1) go to 30
7152  IF (iw(jpos-1).LT.0) go to 60
7153  30 jpiv = 1
7154  apos = apos - (liell+1-ipiv)
7155  ist = ipiv + 1
7156  w1 = w(ipiv)*a(apos)
7157  IF (liell.LT.ist) go to 50
7158  jj1 = apos + 1
7159  DO 40 j = ist,liell
7160  w1 = w1 + a(jj1)*w(j)
7161  jj1 = jj1 + 1
7162  40 CONTINUE
7163  50 w(ipiv) = w1
7164  jpos = jpos - 1
7165  go to 90
7166  60 jpiv = 2
7167  apos2 = apos - (liell+1-ipiv)
7168  apos = apos2 - (liell+2-ipiv)
7169  ist = ipiv + 1
7170  w1 = w(ipiv-1)*a(apos) + w(ipiv)*a(apos+1)
7171  w2 = w(ipiv-1)*a(apos+1) + w(ipiv)*a(apos2)
7172  IF (liell.LT.ist) go to 80
7173  jj1 = apos + 2
7174  jj2 = apos2 + 1
7175  DO 70 j = ist,liell
7176  w1 = w1 + w(j)*a(jj1)
7177  w2 = w2 + w(j)*a(jj2)
7178  jj1 = jj1 + 1
7179  jj2 = jj2 + 1
7180  70 CONTINUE
7181  80 w(ipiv-1) = w1
7182  w(ipiv) = w2
7183  jpos = jpos - 2
7184  90 CONTINUE
7185  ifr = 0
7186  DO 100 jj = j1,j2
7187  j = abs(iw(jj)+0)
7188  ifr = ifr + 1
7189  rhs(j) = w(ifr)
7190  100 CONTINUE
7191  npiv = 0
7192  go to 180
7193  110 IF (npiv.EQ.1) go to 120
7194  IF (iw(jpos-1).LT.0) go to 150
7195  120 npiv = npiv - 1
7196  apos = apos - (j2-jpos+1)
7197  iirhs = iw(jpos)
7198  w1 = rhs(iirhs)*a(apos)
7199  j1 = jpos + 1
7200  IF (j1.GT.j2) go to 140
7201  k = apos + 1
7202  DO 130 j = j1,j2
7203  irhs = abs(iw(j)+0)
7204  w1 = w1 + a(k)*rhs(irhs)
7205  k = k + 1
7206  130 CONTINUE
7207  140 rhs(iirhs) = w1
7208  jpos = jpos - 1
7209  go to 180
7210  150 npiv = npiv - 2
7211  apos2 = apos - (j2-jpos+1)
7212  apos = apos2 - (j2-jpos+2)
7213  i1rhs = -iw(jpos-1)
7214  i2rhs = iw(jpos)
7215  w1 = rhs(i1rhs)*a(apos) + rhs(i2rhs)*a(apos+1)
7216  w2 = rhs(i1rhs)*a(apos+1) + rhs(i2rhs)*a(apos2)
7217  j1 = jpos + 1
7218  IF (j1.GT.j2) go to 170
7219  jj1 = apos + 2
7220  jj2 = apos2 + 1
7221  DO 160 j = j1,j2
7222  irhs = abs(iw(j)+0)
7223  w1 = w1 + rhs(irhs)*a(jj1)
7224  w2 = w2 + rhs(irhs)*a(jj2)
7225  jj1 = jj1 + 1
7226  jj2 = jj2 + 1
7227  160 CONTINUE
7228  170 rhs(i1rhs) = w1
7229  rhs(i2rhs) = w2
7230  jpos = jpos - 2
7231  180 CONTINUE
7232  190 RETURN
7233  END

7280  DOUBLE PRECISION FUNCTION fa01ad(I)

7296  END

7331 c *******************************************
7332 c Pontos e pesos de gauss
7333 c *******************************************
7334  subroutine gauss(nga,qsiga,wga)
7335 
7336  integer*4 nga,iga,jga,mga
7337  real*8 x1ga,x2ga,qsiga(20),wga(20),p1ga,p2ga,p3ga,ppga
7338  #,xlga,xmga,zga,z1ga,pi
7339  pi=2.*datan2(1.d0,0.d0) !definido pi radianos
7340  x1ga=-1.
7341  x2ga=1.
7342  mga=(nga+1)/2
7343  xmga=0.d0
7344  xlga=1.d0
7345  do iga=1,mga
7346  zga=cos(pi*(iga-.25d0)/(nga+.5d0))
7347  1 continue !Newton rapson para refinar raiz
7348  p1ga=1.d0
7349  p2ga=0.d0
7350  do jga=1,nga
7351  p3ga=p2ga
7352  p2ga=p1ga
7353  p1ga=((2.d0*jga-1.d0)*zga*p2ga-(jga-1.d0)*p3ga)/(jga*1.d0)
7354  enddo
7355  ppga=nga*(zga*p1ga-p2ga)/(zga*zga-1.d0)
7356  z1ga=zga
7357  zga=z1ga-p1ga/ppga
7358  if(dabs(zga-z1ga).gt.1.d-15) goto 1 !Newton Rapson
7359  qsiga(iga)=xmga-xlga*zga
7360  qsiga(nga+1-iga)=xmga+xlga*zga
7361  wga(iga)=2.d0*xlga/((1.d0-zga*zga)*ppga*ppga)
7362  wga(nga+1-iga)=wga(iga)
7363  enddo
7364 
7365 c do iga=1,nga
7366 c write(*,*) iga,qsiga(iga),wga(iga)
7367 c enddo
7368 
7369  return
7370  end

7373 !****************************************************************************
7374 !
7375 ! ROTINA: INVERSE
7376 !
7377 ! PROPÓSITO: Inverter uma matriz
7378 !
7379 !
7380 !****************************************************************************
7381  subroutine inverse(iEq, dbMin,dbMout)
7382 
7383  implicit none
7384  integer ii, ij, ik, ieq
7385  real*8 dbmin(ieq,ieq), dbmout(ieq,ieq)
7386  real*8 id(ieq,ieq), dbaux
7387 
7388 
7389  ! iEq - numero de equações
7390  ! dbMin - Matriz a ser resolvida
7391 
7392  ! Gera a matriz identidade (onde estará a resposta - dbMout)
7393  ! Copia dbMin para não alterá-la - Id no final será a matriz identidade
7394 
7395  do ii = 1,ieq
7396  do ij = 1,ieq
7397  if (ii .eq. ij) then
7398  dbmout(ii,ij) = 1.d0
7399  else
7400  dbmout(ii,ij) = 0.d0
7401  end if
7402 
7403 c Id(ii,ij) = dbMin(ii,ij)
7404  end do
7405  end do
7406 
7407  do ii=1, ieq
7408  if (dabs(dbmin(ii,ii)) .lt. 1.d-10) then
7409  do ij=1, ieq
7410  if (dabs(dbmin(ij,ii)).gt.1.d-10) then
7411  do ik=1,ieq
7412  dbmin(ii,ik)=dbmin(ii,ik)+dbmin(ij,ik)
7413  dbmout(ii,ik)=dbmout(ii,ik)+dbmout(ij,ik)
7414  enddo
7415  endif
7416  enddo
7417  else
7418  endif
7419  enddo
7420 
7421 
7422  id=dbmin
7423 
7424  do ii = 1,ieq
7425  dbaux = id(ii,ii)
7426  do ij=1,ieq
7427  id(ii,ij) = id(ii,ij) / dbaux
7428  dbmout(ii,ij) = dbmout(ii,ij) / dbaux
7429  end do
7430 
7431  do ik = ii+1,ieq
7432  if (id(ik,ii) .ne. 0.d0) then
7433  dbaux = id(ik,ii)
7434 
7435 
7436  do ij = 1,ieq
7437  id(ik,ij) = id(ik,ij) - id(ii,ij) * dbaux
7438  dbmout(ik,ij) = dbmout(ik,ij) -
7439  # dbmout(ii,ij) * dbaux
7440  end do
7441  end if
7442  end do
7443  end do
7444 
7445  do ii = ieq,1,-1
7446  do ik = ii-1,1,-1
7447  if (id(ik,ii) .ne. 0.d0) then
7448  dbaux = id(ik,ii)
7449 
7450  do ij = ieq, 1, -1
7451  id(ik,ij) = id(ik,ij) - id(ii,ij) * dbaux
7452  dbmout(ik,ij) = dbmout(ik,ij) -
7453  # dbmout(ii,ij) * dbaux
7454  end do
7455  end if
7456  end do
7457  end do
7458 
7459  return
7460  end

7500  subroutine searchcorrespondencefluid(x_, y_ , ielem, xsi)
7501  USE big_stuff
7502  USE bloclagatbig
7503  implicit none
7504  integer*4 node, ielem, inode, k, iterations, il
7505  real*8 x_, y_, xsi, xsi_tent, x_c, y_c, error, deltax(2),
7506  $ deltaxsi(2), eta
7507 ! implicit real*8(a-h),integer*4(i-n),real*8(o-z)
7508 
7509  xsi = 1.d8
7510  ielem = 1000000
7511 
7512  do j = 1,nel
7513 
7514  xsi1 = 0.d0
7515 
7516  call suportefuncoesdeforma
7517  call formaederi0
7518 
7519  call calc_a0
7520  call inverse(2,a0,a0inv)

7523  y_c = 0.d0
